problem.title: How to get the path and name of the Python file that is currently executing?
problem.description: I have scripts calling other script files but I need to get the filepath of the file that is currently running within the process. For example, let's say I have three files. Using execfile : script_1.py calls script_2.py . In turn, script_2.py calls script_3.py . How can I get the file name and path of script_3.py , from code within script_3.py , without having to pass that information as arguments from script_2.py ?
